    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ApiCodeValue
    Centralised registry of integer API codes used by the authentication and authorisation layers of the easy-4-java security stack.
    AuthConstants
    Collection of string constants used throughout the authentication and authorisation layers of the easy-4-java security stack.
    AuthenticatingFailureCounter
    SPI used by the easy-4-java security stack to track the number of failed authentication attempts per request.
    AuthResponse<T>
    Generic response envelope returned by the authentication and authorisation layers to API clients.
    AuthResponseCode
    Enumeration of response codes used by the authentication and authorisation layers of the easy-4-java security stack.
    CaptchaResolver
    Strategy abstraction for verifying and storing captcha values across HTTP requests.
    HeaderCacheControlProperties
    Configuration properties that control the Cache-Control response header written by the security filter.
    HeaderContentTypeOptionsProperties
    Configuration properties that control the X-Content-Type-Options response header written by the security filter.
    HeaderFrameOptionsProperties
    Configuration properties that control the X-Frame-Options response header written by the security filter.
    HeaderHpkpProperties
    Configuration properties that control the HTTP Public Key Pinning (HPKP) response header written by the security filter.
    HeaderHstsProperties
    Configuration properties that control the HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) response header written by the security filter.
    HeaderXssProtectionProperties
    Configuration properties that control the browser XSS protection header written by the security filter.
    JwtPayloadRepository
    Repository abstraction for issuing, verifying and parsing JSON Web Tokens within the easy-4-java security stack.
    NullCaptchaResolver
    No-op CaptchaResolver that always reports the captcha as valid.
    PostLoginRequest
    Request body model consumed by the REST-mode login endpoint.
    SecurityEntryPointProperties
    Configuration properties that control the AuthenticationEntryPoint behaviour used by the easy-4-java security stack.
    SecurityLogoutProperties
    Configuration properties that control the behaviour of the logout filter.
    SecurityPrincipal
    Extended Spring Security User that carries the domain-specific identity (uid, uuid, ukey, ucode) and role/permission information required by the easy-4-java security stack.
    SecurityRedirectProperties
    Configuration properties that control how Spring Security calculates redirect URLs.
    SecurityRequestProperties
    Placeholder configuration properties for request-scoped security settings.
    SessionFixationPolicy
    Strategy that describes how the security framework should mitigate session-fixation attacks by changing the session identifier after authentication.
    UserProfilePayload
    Carrier object that exposes the user's profile information to API clients.
